title: Team Session
description: Shared mutable session state, stored at <git-common-dir>/team-layer/sessions/<slug>/session.json. `revision` is the compare-and-swap guard: a writer passes the revision it read and its write is refused if anything moved underneath it. `eventSeq` is authoritative for how many events events.jsonl must hold, so a truncated log is detectable rather than silently short.

integrationTarget.description: The branch this session integrates into. Recorded on the session rather than per task, because two tasks in one session merging to different targets is a split session, not a shared one.

eventSeq.description: Count of events appended to events.jsonl. Written before the event itself, so a crash between the two reads as a truncated log instead of an event nothing accounts for.

canonicalProvider.description: Which layer resolves canonical input revisions for this session, e.g. "spec-suite". Absent means compatibility mode: revisions are recorded as declared and cannot be re-resolved.
